text_en:
余韵护盾 · D-3 Class Continuity Retention Aid

Distributed to: Primate Auxiliary Documentation Department employees who have completed no fewer than two consecutive KPI cycles without interruption-related incident notation in their behavioral archive.

This aid is issued for use during high-volume transcription periods. Holders have reported that workflow momentum "does not collapse as completely as expected" following minor interruption events. Root cause has not been submitted for review.

Operating Guidelines:
—— Do not attempt to transfer this aid to adjacent workstations. Three cross-issuance incidents have been logged by the Physical Assets Management Center. Two remain under review.
—— This aid has not been cleared for use beyond the standard transcription floor. Personnel who have carried it past the 4th floor stairwell landing are advised to consult the relevant incident filing form (Form 77-C, available from HR).
—— Holders who report "residual output continuity" following verified interruption events are instructed to document the instance on Supplementary Log Sheet B and deposit it in the inter-floor collection tray by end of shift. Do not retain copies.
—— Upon reassignment or departure, this aid must be returned to HR alongside any attached documentation. Unreturned units are flagged automatically. Replacement will not be issued.
